description: Rent-paying band (fleet-ops#1223; ledger 2026-08-27 | Precedence band + overnight machinery surge). From cutoff_utc, blanket fleet-ops precedence ends: machinery (fleet-ops issue lanes) is capped at machinery_max_pct of live pi-issue@ units, product the rest, with product_front claimed first. Machinery jumps the band only by a `band-multiplier: N` line on the issue body. Weekly Fleet Review owns this dial via the quality ratchet (tighten only; canary fails if machinery_max_pct > 30 or product_min_pct < 70). Until cutoff: surge — fleet-ops intake claims only surge_leverage_issues.
